title: Cosmo hears clip audio
description: Umbrella MPI-1170: a clip with sound is transcribed through the user's selected transcriber (ComfyUI qwen3-asr is good and light; DeepInfra caps at 60 s/25 MB) and Cosmo reads the words with its 6 frames. Plus one line: Cosmo views only 6 frames to stay cheap and points the user to MCP for more.
